grammar.label: past continuous — form and use
grammar.meaning: an action in progress at a point in the past

explanation.en: Use was/were + -ing for something that was already happening at a past moment.
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun was/were + -ing ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: At six o'clock I was working.

l1_notes.uz: 'was/were' tushib qolmasligi kerak; son bo'yicha mos kelishi shart.

grammar.label: past continuous vs past simple — while / when / as
grammar.form: When + past simple, past continuous / While + past continuous, past simple
grammar.meaning: a short action interrupting a longer one

explanation.en: The long action takes the continuous; the short action that interrupts it takes the simple.
explanation.uz: Uzun ish — davomiy zamon; uni bo'lgan qisqa ish — oddiy o'tgan zamon.

grammar.positive_example: I was walking home when I saw him.
grammar.negative_example: I walked home when I was seeing him.

l1_notes.uz: 'while' odatda davomiy bilan, 'when' odatda oddiy o'tgan zamon bilan keladi.

explanation.en: Learn these in pattern groups, not alphabetically: bring/brought, buy/bought, think/thought all share one pattern.
explanation.uz: Bularni alifbo tartibida emas, NAQSH bo'yicha guruhlab yodlang: bring/brought, buy/bought, think/thought — bir xil naqsh.

l1_notes.uz: Naqsh bo'yicha guruhlash yodlash vaqtini yarim baravar qisqartiradi.
